rationale: B01 is an aggregate coverage flag reporting that 58 of 116 leaves have fair_value. The raw 2025 investment schedule has explicit Cost and Fair Value columns, and its Total Investments row reports cost 199,200 and fair value 184,466; the extracted 2025 holdings slice carries fair_value for the shown positions and ties structurally to the schedule total. The 50% metric is therefore consistent with counting cost leaves together with fair-value leaves in the denominator, not with missing fair values in the raw source.
